sections.heading: Proposal Summary
sections.text: This proposal, SYN-SYNCP000159-P1, was presented by the Supplier to Horizon Wellness Center 159 on November 12, 2025.

sections.heading: Supplier Concession
sections.text: Supplier concession: an administrative fee of 2.25%.

sections.heading: Supplier Request
sections.text: Supplier request: a Influenza share floor of 65%.

sections.heading: Proposal Status
sections.text: Status of this proposal: declined by the Customer.
